archetypes.name: dyn-ledger-roundtrip
archetypes.rationale: Ledger writes and prompt reads must share the same root across nested and flat rounds.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on the changed findings ledger root resolution and every caller that writes or renders the ledger. Verify nested implement rounds, standalone review rounds, and design plan-review rounds all point to the same per-invocation file. Check that pre-MAV tallies do not replace ledger rows and that re-tallies upsert the current round. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-prompt-safety
archetypes.rationale: The ledger is untrusted reviewer prose injected into external-agent prompts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the prompt_section sanitization and renderer injection sites. Verify TSV cells cannot introduce instructions through tabs, newlines, or tag-like text, and check that reviewer and judge policy wording changes correctly when LARCH_LEDGER_KEEP_NEUTRAL is set. Confirm render_reviewer_main remains outside this feature. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
